objects.name: Analytic 2259
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a vendor firmware update utility executing outside a scheduled maintenance window or invoked by an account not in the approved firmware management role, immediately followed by a network session to a field device IP on its firmware protocol port. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
